intro: NACI Robotics is a passionate high school robotics team from Rexdale, Ontario, with 30+ members. We compete in FIRST, a global robotics competition, and are dedicated to learning, building, and inspiring through STEM. Beyond competing, we run youth workshops, school demos, and mentor other teams to make STEM accessible to all.
about: Founded in 2009, 2935 NACI Robotics is a proud FIRST Robotics team representing North Albion Collegiate Institute. Our team brings together passionate students who design, build, and program competitive robots while developing real-world engineering, teamwork, and leadership skills. We strive to inspire innovation, creativity, and community through the spirit of STEM and collaboration.
